about_the_game:
Game Description:

Three years ago, an unexplained supernatural event occurred in Hoshino Town. Mizuki and her team went in to investigate and discovered that the town's residents had mysteriously disappeared and transformed into vengeful spirits. The other members of the investigation team never returned, leaving Mizuki as the only survivor. As the events spread, the police established a "Supernatural Investigation Unit." Now, new supernatural incidents have erupted, and Mizuki needs your help. Will you join her to uncover the mysteries and stop the disaster?

Gameplay Features:

  • Personalized Female Protagonist: Customize Mizuki's appearance with various outfits, hairstyles, accessories, and more, creating a unique look for your character.

  • Combat Experience: Engage in smooth combat with a combination of melee weapons, firearms, and bows, offering fluid and satisfying action.

  • Stealth and Assassination: Use stealth and assassination skills to avoid enemies or take them out with precision.

  • Supernatural Atmosphere: Face mysterious vengeful spirits and unexplained phenomena while uncovering the horrifying truth behind Hoshino Town.

  • Engaging Storyline: As the story unfolds, uncover the hidden supernatural events and mysteries.

Independently Developed:

Developed by an independent creator, aiming to create a challenging and thrilling supernatural horror adventure game. Thank you for your support! The game is still in development.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains mild violence and some characters with revealing outfits. All content is fictional and intended for entertainment purposes only. Please do not attempt to replicate any actions from the game in real life.
